description: This Java interface, EcuDataConvertor, defines methods for converting ECU data from byte arrays to other data formats, formatting values, and retrieving data-related metadata in a vehicle ECU context.

classes.name: EcuDataConvertor
classes.description: An interface defining methods for converting raw ECU data bytes into usable formats and retrieving associated metadata.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a byte array representing ECU data into a double value.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the given double value, formatted for display.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units associated with the data values, such as 'psi' or '°C'.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the formatting string or type used for representing the data.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Returns the expression or formula used to derive the data value.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the ECU data, such as 'float', 'int', etc.
